verbs.plain: Finish what is already there. Nothing off the spacing grid, nothing too faint to read, nothing you cannot reach with a keyboard. Polish never redesigns; it only removes defects that a tool can count.

patterns.name: Spacing sits on a 4px scale
patterns.pass_criteria: no padding, margin or gap on a visible element is off the 4px scale

patterns.name: Text contrast is at least 4.5:1
patterns.pass_criteria: axe reports 0 color-contrast violations and every listed text pair is >= 4.5:1

patterns.name: Keyboard focus is visible
patterns.pass_criteria: no `outline: none/0` declaration remains in the stylesheet

patterns.name: Tap targets are at least 44x44px
patterns.pass_criteria: every visible interactive element measures at least 44x44 CSS px

patterns.name: Motion gives way to prefers-reduced-motion
patterns.pass_criteria: under emulated reduced motion no element has a transition or animation longer than 1ms

verbs.plain: Motion that is quick enough to feel like feedback, and that gives way when a person asks for less motion.

patterns.name: State-change motion is 500ms or shorter
patterns.pass_criteria: no element has a transition-duration above 500ms

patterns.name: Motion gives way to prefers-reduced-motion
patterns.pass_criteria: under emulated reduced motion no element has a transition or animation longer than 1ms

verbs.plain: Make the same interface work on a phone and on a desktop: targets you can tap and content that does not spill off the side.
verbs.stays_subjective: Which content to drop or reorder for small screens.

patterns.name: Tap targets are at least 44x44px
patterns.pass_criteria: every visible interactive element measures at least 44x44 CSS px

patterns.name: Content fits a 320px-wide screen
patterns.pass_criteria: no visible element's right edge is past the 320px viewport

patterns.name: Text is at least 14px (body 16px)
patterns.pass_criteria: no checked text element computes below 14px

verbs.plain: Make text comfortable to read: big enough, spaced enough, and not too wide.
verbs.stays_subjective: Whether the typeface has the right personality.

patterns.name: Running text is at most 80 characters wide
patterns.pass_criteria: no paragraph of more than 80 characters renders wider than about 80 characters

patterns.name: Running text has line-height of at least 1.5
patterns.pass_criteria: every paragraph over 40 characters has computed line-height / font-size >= 1.5

patterns.name: Text is at least 14px (body 16px)
patterns.pass_criteria: no checked text element computes below 14px

verbs.plain: Give content a predictable rhythm and a readable line, and make sure it still fits when the screen is narrow.
verbs.stays_subjective: Whether the composition is 'balanced' or 'has breathing room'.

patterns.name: Spacing sits on a 4px scale
patterns.pass_criteria: no padding, margin or gap on a visible element is off the 4px scale

patterns.name: Running text is at most 80 characters wide
patterns.pass_criteria: no paragraph of more than 80 characters renders wider than about 80 characters

patterns.name: Content fits a 320px-wide screen
patterns.pass_criteria: no visible element's right edge is past the 320px viewport

verbs.plain: Run the automated accessibility rules and get a pass or fail list. It tells you what a machine can find, never that the page is good.
verbs.stays_subjective: Everything the rules engines cannot see (meaning, tone, task fit).

patterns.name: Automated accessibility rules report no violations
patterns.pass_criteria: axe reports 0 violations for tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21aa, wcag22aa

verbs.plain: Pull repeated values out of the stylesheet into a small set of named tokens, so a colour or a gap is defined once.
verbs.stays_subjective: Which values deserve a name, and what to call them.

patterns.name: Colours come from a small token set
patterns.pass_criteria: every hex colour in the stylesheet equals a token value and every padding/margin/gap is a multiple of the spacing unit
